This '''deep-space refueling station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in operation during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

==History==
The station refueled the ''[[Arkanian Legacy]]'' prior to its journey to the [[Omonoth system/Legends|Omonoth system]].
